options.name: avatar_url
options.description: Overrides the default avatar of the webhook.

options.name: content
options.description: Content of the message to the Discord channel. At least one of O(content) and O(embeds) must be specified.

options.name: embeds
options.description: Send messages as Embeds to the Discord channel. Embeds can have a colored border, embedded images, text fields and more. Allowed parameters are described in the Discord Docs: U(https://discord.com/developers/docs/resources/channel#embed-object). At least one of O(content) and O(embeds) must be specified.

options.name: tts
options.description: Set this to V(true) if this is a TTS (Text to Speech) message.

options.name: username
options.description: Overrides the default username of the webhook.

options.name: webhook_id
options.description: The webhook ID. Format from Discord webhook URL: C(/webhooks/{webhook.id}/{webhook.token}).

options.name: webhook_token
options.description: The webhook token. Format from Discord webhook URL: C(/webhooks/{webhook.id}/{webhook.token}).
